Turn any PDF, article, note, or screenshot into audio you can listen to anywhere. Clippit is a powerful text-to-speech app that transforms your reading list into a personal, podcast‑style listening experience, perfect for commutes, workouts, or study sessions.

Clippit doesn’t just read text aloud. It turns your content into natural, conversational audio that feels like your favorite podcast.

"Clippit revolutionized how I consume content. Instead of spending hours reading, I can now listen during my commute or walk to college." - Elliot G.

WHY LISTEN INSTEAD OF READ?

Clippit helps you reclaim your time and stay on top of what matters by turning any text into engaging audio:
- Study smarter: Convert lecture notes, slides, and online study guides into a podcast-style review.
- Stay informed on the go: Turn long-form articles, reports, and newsletters into audio you can listen to hands-free.

Audio learning has been shown to improve retention, save time, and enable true multitasking. Clippit makes that accessible for anything you read.

WHAT MAKES CLIPPIT DIFFERENT?

Most text-to-speech apps sound robotic and monotonous. Clippit gives you:

- Podcast-style conversations: Your content is synthesized into a back-and-forth between multiple speakers, so it feels like you’re listening to a real show.
- Voices inspired by your favorite hosts: Choose from different voice styles and tones to match the kind of podcast you love.
- Smart synthesis: Clippit doesn’t just read text; it summarizes and structures it into a more listenable, flowing conversation.

WHAT OUR COMMUNITY IS SAYING

"I love the way the app turns my study notes and class readings into entertaining podcasts while emulating my favourite podcast online" - Emily M.

"I started using NotebookLM, but when I found this app it made it so much easier to listen to content on the go. It does a great job synthesizing the content uploaded and creates a very listenable conversation" - Jennifer S.

"It’s so funny to create podcast clips that sound like Joe Rogan and Alex Cooper" - Daniel Z.

"It’s so much easier to listen to a podcast version of my notes and online study guides to help me study" - Sam R.

- Intelligent Content Import: Easily import PDFs, articles, notes, screenshots, and links. Clippit’s smart content recognition pulls out the text and gets it ready for audio.
- 2-Speaker Conversation Style: Turn dry text into a dynamic two-speaker conversation. Choose from a variety of voice styles inspired by popular podcasters and adjust the duration of each episode.
- Topic Generation: Not sure where to start? Use AI-powered suggestions to generate engaging audio content on any topic, from class subjects to industry trends.
- Customizable Playback: Listen your way, change playback speed, skip forward or back 15 seconds, and pick up right where you left off.

GO PRO

Unlock the full power of Clippit with Clippit Pro:
- Unlimited text-to-audio generations from unlimited sources
- 2-speaker podcast clips
- 10+ high-quality voice options

Need help? Contact us at hi@clippit.fm

record.name: Podcast It: AI Podcast
record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turn anything into a podcast worth listening to.

PodcastIt takes a topic you type, or a video, photo, or audio file already on your phone, and makes a real episode out of it: two hosts, a script written for your subject, and voices that sound like people talking rather than a page being read aloud.

Type "how sourdough starters actually work", pick a style, and a few minutes later the episode is in your library. Generation finishes even if you close the app, and a notification tells you when it is ready.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Start from a topic, a file, or both. A saved video, a photo of a page, a lecture recording: all fair game.
2. Choose how the hosts talk about it, and how long they talk for.
3. Listen. The transcript scrolls with the audio, line by line.

ASK THE HOSTS
Pause on any line and ask what you actually want to know. The hosts answer in a couple of lines, in their own voices, and the answer is woven into the episode right where you paused.

TAP ANY LINE
Touch and hold a line for a plain explanation of what it means, or save it to your deck along with its audio and the lines around it. Your deck keeps every moment worth coming back to in one place.

SIX STYLES
Explainer, Deep dive, Interview, News brief, Storytelling, and Language lesson. The style shapes the whole conversation, not just the intro.

THREE LENGTHS
Short (3–5 min), Standard (8–12 min), or Long (15–20 min).

TWENTY LANGUAGES
Hosts can speak English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Turkish, Hindi, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, or Hebrew. Paired with the Language lesson style, any topic becomes listening practice.

ALSO IN THE APP
• Original cover art for every episode
• Playback speed and script text size you control
• Video episodes stay in sync with the moment being discussed
• Export any episode as an audio file
• Share an episode with a public link, or keep everything private
• One app for iPhone and iPad

CREDITS AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
New accounts get 4 credits to try the app. After that, episodes run on weekly credits: a short episode costs 1, a standard 2, a long 4. Asking the hosts, explanations, and saved lines are always free.

• Basic: 15 credits per week, US$7.99 per week
• Pro: 60 credits per week, US$19.99 per week

Both are auto-renewing weekly subscriptions billed to your Apple Account, shown in your local currency in the app. Your subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings. Switching between Basic and Pro takes effect through the App Store, so you are never paying for two plans at once.

Record solo, bring on a remote guest, or go audio-only. Riverside captures every track locally, so your quality stays sharp even when your connection doesn't. Describe your edit, and Riverside's AI agent makes it. No timeline. No pinching and dragging clips around on a small screen. Podcasters, YouTubers, personal brands, and marketing teams — anyone who wants studio-quality content without the studio.

True local recording for quality independent of your connection
